newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Santa Cruz County, Calif.

text.p: 1996-1997 Teeter Plan Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692, that the County of Santa Cruz,
principal amount of its 1996-1997 Teeter Plan Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes, at public sale.
Sealed bids will be received on:

at 10:00 a.m., Pacific Daylight Savings Time, at the offices of Rod Gunn Associates, Inc., 3010 Old Ranch Parkway, Suite 330, Seal Beach, California 90740, telephone (562) 598-7677. The Notice Inviting Bids and the Preliminary Official Statement pertaining to the Notes are being prepared and may be obtained from Rod Gunn Associates, Inc. at the address and telephone number listed above.
